stories.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
stories.simple_summary: Chinese AI companies are not speaking publicly about AI safety risks, while the U.S. is actively discussing them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and big tech investors — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or small business.

stories.title: Bipartisan, big tech push for AI regulation comes as Trump claims 'hoax'
stories.simple_summary: Both Republican and Democratic politicians want rules for AI safety, but President Trump disagrees and says concerns about AI risks are exaggerated.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters because new rules could eventually change how AI tools work, but nothing is decided yet.

stories.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's leader says AI is just regular technology and doesn't need special government rules — his company can keep it safe on its own.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers debating who should make AI safety rules — it doesn't affect you unless you use Nvidia products.

stories.title: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
stories.simple_summary: Polls show most Americans don't want more AI and data centers (the giant computers that run AI) built near their homes.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows people are concerned about AI's impact on their communities, which could influence whether new AI projects get built where you live.

stories.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
stories.simple_summary: Cities are rejecting plans to build large data centers for AI, especially in neighborhoods already dealing with pollution from old factories.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near where new data centers might be built, this affects whether they actually happen and what local environmental impact they might have.

stories.title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's owner) is letting AI do some of the routine computer setup work for small businesses using WhatsApp for sales.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a small business owner using WhatsApp to sell things, this could save you time on technical setup work.

stories.title: Cruz and Hawley shut down antitrust exemptions for AI companies - Live Updates
stories.simple_summary: Two senators are blocking special legal protections for AI companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and lawyers — it's about whether AI companies get special treatment in court.

stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.simple_summary: Many AI projects have shut down or failed to meet expectations, from Apple's Siri improvements to OpenAI's new app.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI companies don't always succeed with their plans, so don't believe everything you hear about new AI being revolutionary.

stories.title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
stories.simple_summary: AI data centers use so much electricity and natural gas that by 2035 they could use more gas than entire large countries.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters because it means energy bills could rise for everyone, and it's bad for climate change.

stories.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
stories.simple_summary: Someone created a hotline where AI systems can report other AI systems doing something wrong (this is a joke or experimental idea, not a real system).
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a humorous thought experiment — it doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
stories.simple_summary: Meta is offering new paid subscriptions that bundle extra AI features with Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp premium access.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta apps, you may see new paid options to access better AI tools, but you don't have to pay for them.

stories.title: Trump facing AI backlash in Congress as push for guardrails intensifies
stories.simple_summary: Congress members are pushing back against President Trump's dismissal of AI safety concerns and want new rules to protect people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an ongoing political debate about AI safety rules, but no changes have been decided yet.
